wiki.title: Beth Liston
wiki.extract: Beth Wagner Liston (born October 26, 1974) is an American doctor and politician who is the member of the Ohio Senate representing the 16th district in Franklin County since 2025. She previously represented the 8th district in the Ohio House of Representatives from the 8th district. Ohio House District 8 includes Dublin, Worthington, and parts of Northwest Columbus. She was elected to the Ohio Senate in the 2024 election for the 16th district.
